name: PowerShell Core DLL Loaded By Non PowerShell Process
description:
Detects loading of essential DLLs used by PowerShell by non-PowerShell process.
Detects behavior similar to meterpreter's "load powershell" extension.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Used by some .NET binaries, minimal on user workstation.
Used by Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio
query: (file.pe.description:System.Management.Automation OR file.pe.original_file_name:System.Management.Automation.dll OR (file.path:(*\\System.Management.Automation.dll OR *\\System.Management.Automation.ni.dll))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\dsac.exe OR *\:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\runscripthelper.exe OR *\:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\sdiagnhost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\ServerManager.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\winrshost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\wsmprovhost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\winrshost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\wsmprovhost.exe)) OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\*)) AND process.executable:*\\mscorsvw.exe))) AND (NOT (((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ SQL\ Server\ Management\ Studio* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ SQL\ Server\ Management\ Studio*)) AND process.executable:*\\IDE\\Ssms.exe) OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ SQL\ Server\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ SQL\ Server\\*)) AND process.executable:*\\Tools\\Binn\\SQLPS.exe) OR process.executable:*\\Citrix\\ConfigSync\\ConfigSyncRun.exe OR (process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Visual\ Studio\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Visual\ Studio\\*)) OR process.executable:*\:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\choco.exe* OR (process.executable:*\:\\Windows\\Temp\\asgard2\-agent\\* AND (process.executable:(*\\thor64.exe OR *\\thor.exe))) OR (NOT _exists_:process.executable)))
